The authors found that all four patients who underwent radial head excision dislocated after surgery. Only four patients had a satisfactory result, and all of these had fixation of the radial head, two requiring concomitant repair of the lateral ulnar collateral ligament (LUCL). The authors concluded that terrible triad injuries were unstable, prone to redislocation and that radiocapitellar contact is critical for ulnohumeral stability.
